column5: A declared stand-in: 2024-T4 against the bars' EN AW-2017A (the same Al-Cu family), a 4.7 mm beam against a 12 mm bar, one mode at 1063 Hz. At 5.6e-4 atm the beam's air share (radiation plus viscous air loss, 0.0606 1/s of its 1 atm decay) is gone; what stays is the alloy's own loss, loaded by the strain gages and threads. This is the loss bar_self_radiation pairs with: the bar's own radiation comes back from the engine's Burton-Miller solve, and the viscous air loss is declared out, not modelled
